observations: I opened assets/panels/07-1.png, main-cast.png, checkin-patients.png and page-07.png and looked at them myself. The setting is back at reception. Meera is at the left leaning on the desk with a reception monitor and plant in front of her. Ravi is at the right. The waiting chairs and three seated figures seen from behind are in the background.

Meera matches her sheet: round face, large round eyes, high arched brows, braid over her left shoulder with a teal tie, blue printed kurta, and the silver bangle on the pointing wrist (her right). She points at the phone with her index finger and rests her other hand on the desk.

Ravi matches his sheet. He holds his dark-blue-cased phone in his right hand with the back toward the reader, so the screen is not visible, as the scene requires. His left hand, with the watch, rests on the desk edge. The bag is on his shoulder.
A framed picture on the wall shows only an abstract blue image. I found no readable text.
On page-07.png the balloon is at the upper left with its tail to Meera. It does not cover either face, the pointing hand or the phone.
